title: AtlasDatasetRecord
description: A canonical atlas record for one dataset or paper, produced by LLM-assisted enrichment from a seed.schema.json entry and validated before merge. References publications.json and platforms.json by id instead of embedding them.

atlas_id.description: Stable atlas-assigned id, immutable once assigned. Not the same as any external accession.

record_type.description: Mirrors seed.source_type. DATASET has independently browsable deposited data; PAPER is a publication with no separate dataset accession.

conditions.description: One entry per condition/control group, replacing the old semicolon-aligned 'Conditions' + 'sample n by condition' columns so counts can't drift out of sync with labels.

available_metadata.description: Clinical/demographic variables available alongside the samples, e.g. ['age', 'sex'].

platforms.description: Platforms used, with the protein/feature count as reported for THIS study. Array because some papers report more than one platform (e.g. discovery + validation array). n_proteins_reported lives here rather than on platform.schema.json because the legacy data showed the same named platform reporting wildly different counts across studies (QC filtering, array version, subset analyzed) — it is not a fixed platform attribute.

dataset_link.description: Primary URL for this record (dataset landing page, or paper link if record_type is PAPER).

related_atlas_ids.description: Other atlas records this one relates to (e.g. sibling sub-series of a superseries). Points to atlas_id, not raw external accessions.

publication_id.description: Reference to publications.json publication_id, or null if no associated publication.

curated_availability.description: Availability as assessed at curation/enrichment time. Distinct from link_status.schema.json, which tracks ongoing automated reachability checks over time.

data_status.description: available = raw or processed data can be downloaded now. upon_request = authors must be contacted. unavailable = confirmed not obtainable. unknown = not yet determined.

data_content.description: What form the available data takes. Only meaningful when data_status is 'available'.

seed_id.description: seed_id of the seed.schema.json entry this record was enriched from.
